hypothesis: A compact exact-pair translation name and UTF-8 text-artifact scope will improve discovery and reuse without weakening language-pair or format-safety controls.

evidence_sources.summary: The requested skill must apply beyond webpages while preserving one input-output language-pair control.
AGENTS.md requires lowercase okhp3 names, package paths at or below 36 characters, composable skills, and public-safe artifacts.
The 0.2.0 equilibrium review supported exact-pair structure but is historical after this breaking rename.

review_passes.result: No competing format-agnostic translation family found; universal remains the closest reusable family.
Major-version rename, focused frontmatter, format boundary, evaluation design, and deterministic helpers reviewed.
1.0.0 analytical review approved with limits; no independent or native-language quality evidence.

changes.change: Renamed to okhp3-translation-en-us-fr-fr and raised version to 1.0.0.
changes.expected_benefit: Exact-pair naming is adjacent and reusable beyond webpages.
changes.regression_risk: Existing callers using the old package name must migrate.

changes.change: Generalized supported inputs to UTF-8 text artifacts and added a binary-format adapter boundary.
changes.expected_benefit: Markdown and other text artifacts have the same controlled pair workflow.
changes.regression_risk: Users could overread format support; the SKILL explicitly blocks direct binary editing.

changes.change: Renamed planner output from pages to artifacts and expanded configured text extensions.
changes.expected_benefit: Machine-readable output matches the public contract.
changes.regression_risk: Consumers of the old planner output must update their key lookup.

decision: retain the remastered exact-pair package as the canonical distribution candidate; promote a byte-verified mirror after final validation.
applicability_limits: No direct DOCX, PDF, slide, spreadsheet, or image translation.
No other target locale without a separate exact-pair package.
